obligations.subject: e2
obligations.response: the provisions of paragraphs 5.1. and 5.2. shall, in addition to the normal running condition as specified by the manufacturer for a vehicle speed of 40 km/h, be met for all adjustable vehicle steady heights corresponding to vehicle speeds from 25 up to 40 km/h
obligations.ears: When a vehicle is fitted with an ARHSS which could change the vehicle height at the front axle more than 20 mm from the nominal for any vehicle speed between 25 and 40 km/h, the vehicle shall, in addition to the normal running condition as specified by the manufacturer for a vehicle speed of 40 km/h, meet the provisions of paragraphs 5.1. and 5.2. for all adjustable vehicle steady heights corresponding to vehicle speeds from 25 up to 40 km/h.
